title: Restriction-induced chain components commute with the MV arrows
statement: For h:X→Y, opens U,V of Y, complexes I on X and J on Y and any chain map f:h_*I→J, use the explicit components of [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. Let b be the biproduct lift of h_* of the two projections followed by the U and V components. Then h_* of the Mayer–Vietoris pair of units followed by b equals f followed by the pair of units of J; h_* of the difference of restrictions followed by the intersection component equals b followed by the difference of restrictions of J. No cover or injectivity hypotheses are needed.

proof.text: Identify schemeMVImageIso with the existing schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison by expanding their formal constructions. Equality induction identifies Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr with eqToIso. Reuse schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison_unit and schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison_restriction (with symmetry) for the two ordinary compatibility equations; no new sectionwise calculation or adjunction-cancellation proof is needed.

Apply these two ordinary compatibilities degreewise. Naturality of the open unit and nested restriction transformation with respect to f gives the equations for schemeMVImageComponent on arbitrary complexes, without K-injectivity or a cover hypothesis.

Postcompose with the biproduct projections and use the unit-component equations to obtain the first square. For the second, instantiate the private proved map_biprod_desc_square calculation, which expands the desc into projection composites and uses additivity and preservation of negation with the two restriction equations. This works for empty and equal opens as well.

theorem schemeMV_image_chain_squares
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let b := biprod.lift
      (F.map biprod.fst ≫ schemeMVImageComponent h U I J f)
      (F.map biprod.snd ≫ schemeMVImageComponent h V I J f)
    (F.map (schemeMayerVietorisF X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) I) ≫ b =
      f ≫ schemeMayerVietorisF Y U V J) ∧
    (F.map (schemeMayerVietorisG X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) I) ≫
        schemeMVImageComponent h (U ⊓ V) I J f =
      b ≫ schemeMayerVietorisG Y U V J)
